kultivator.guide.chapter.15.desc: Traits, moods, friendships, the stair trial, scriptures, ancestors, elders and the successor.
kultivator.guide.chapter.16.desc: Emblem and banners, tournaments, missions, garden and mine, other sects: allies or foes.
kultivator.guide.c15.sifat.title: Learn your disciple's nature
kultivator.guide.c15.sifat.body:
Every disciple has two traits (sometimes three), such as Diligent and Loyal, or Lazy and Arrogant.
Open its scroll or type the command: traits change how fast it trains, how much it works and how loyal it stays.
Traits cannot be bought; only certain trials of the heart can shift them.
kultivator.guide.c15.puas.title: Make a disciple truly content
kultivator.guide.c15.puas.body:
Contentment (0-100) rises when you teach, give pills, meditate together, praise its victories and honour the ancestors.
It falls when the disciple is struck, neglected, overworked or humiliated.
Talk to it once a day, give a gift (pill, herb, spirit stone) or apologise before the Hall stele.
Bring one disciple to 90.
kultivator.guide.c15.rukun.title: Calm a defiant disciple
kultivator.guide.c15.rukun.body:
A disciple whose loyalty falls turns Restless, then Defiant (refuses duties), then prepares to leave.
Talk to it, give a gift, apologise before the Hall or leave it to the Discipline Elder (if you have one).
A disciple bound by the Soul Seal never runs away.
kultivator.guide.c15.sahabat.title: See two disciples become friends
kultivator.guide.c15.sahabat.body:
Disciples who meet often share tea; traits, Dao and shared deeds decide whether they get along.
Friends help each other in fights and on missions.
See the Web of Ties in the Sect hub or the Ties tab of the disciple scroll.
kultivator.guide.c15.saingan.title: A rivalry is born
kultivator.guide.c15.saingan.body:
Arena defeats and unfair promotions breed rivals, even grudges.
Rivalry spurs training; a grudge sours the mood.
An Honour Duel before the sect can turn a grudge into a rivalry.
kultivator.guide.c15.tangga.title: Hold the Thousand-Step Trial
kultivator.guide.c15.tangga.body:
Build the Trial Stair before the gate (a sect component, from the materials you deposit).
When you test a candidate (an amethyst shard, as before), it climbs an illusory thousand-step stair under rising pressure.
Those who reach the top join with a steadfast heart.
A disciple may climb again: /kultivasi perguruan tangga ujian <name> (200 PK, once per 30 days).
kultivator.guide.c15.kitab.title: A disciple studies alone in the Scripture Pavilion
kultivator.guide.c15.kitab.body:
Click the Scripture Pavilion with a technique manual in hand to shelve it (or open the hub card Pavilion & Tombs).
Idle disciples sit and read, slowly learning the technique without spending your Qi.
The Scripture Elder speeds their study.
kultivator.guide.c15.leluhur.title: Honour the ancestors
kultivator.guide.c15.leluhur.body:
Fallen disciples rest in the Sect Cemetery; their spirit tablets stand on the Ancestral Altar.
Offer incense and hold the rites: the ancestors' blessing calms the disciples' hearts.
Incense is crafted from a stick, charcoal and sweet berries; the great Qingming rite comes every 15 days.
kultivator.guide.c15.tetua.title: Appoint an elder
kultivator.guide.c15.tetua.body:
A disciple of Elder rank can hold an office: Discipline, Scripture, Treasury, Outer Affairs or Medicine.
Elders run the daily affairs on their own and report to you every morning.
The Steward Elder leads them all.
kultivator.guide.c15.penerus.title: Hand the seat to your heir
kultivator.guide.c15.penerus.body:
A named heir strong enough can be crowned second-generation Sect Master.
You become the Founding Patriarch; the sect runs on in your successor's hands.
Choose fairly: the disciples passed over will remember.
kultivator.guide.c16.lambang.title: Design the sect emblem
kultivator.guide.c16.lambang.body:
Choose a shape, a symbol, three colours and the sect's motto.
The emblem shows on banners, the gate, the formations and the disciples' robes.
kultivator.guide.c16.bendera.title: Raise the sect banners
kultivator.guide.c16.bendera.body:
Banner poles at the gate and around the formation disc are built from deposited materials.
The formation poles come at tier 4. Set each rank's uniform colours in the hub card Sect > Emblem & Uniform.
kultivator.guide.c16.turnamen.title: Crown a sect tournament champion
kultivator.guide.c16.turnamen.body:
Build the lei tai stands (templates 6-9, tier 7): tournaments move to the arena stage with spectators, a Sword Duel every round and a seasonal Elo board.
NPC sects may come to challenge you in an inter-sect tournament.
Victory breeds pride; defeat may breed a rival.
kultivator.guide.c16.misi.title: Welcome a mission team home
kultivator.guide.c16.misi.body:
Send disciples out on story missions: escorting caravans, hunting demonic beasts, exploring ruins.
They return through the gate with a written report of what happened.
kultivator.guide.c16.bawa.title: A disciple brings something home
kultivator.guide.c16.bawa.body:
Sometimes a team brings a gifted youth home as a candidate, or a treasure it found.
The team's traits and ties change the outcome.
kultivator.guide.c16.kebun.title: Harvest the herb garden
kultivator.guide.c16.kebun.body:
Click a bed's soil or open the hub card Garden & Mine to sow spirit herbs; disciples tend them every day.
Nothing is actually planted in the world: the harvest goes to the Storehouse.
kultivator.guide.c16.tambang.title: Work the Spirit Mine
kultivator.guide.c16.tambang.body:
The mine mouth is built on the sect's hillside; disciples take shifts inside and come out with spirit stones and ore.
The deeper the level, the richer the yield and the greater the danger.
Click the mine mouth to open its board. No block is ever dug.
kultivator.guide.c16.rival.title: Find another sect
kultivator.guide.c16.rival.body:
NPC sects have their own mountain gates in the world; they grow and fight one another.
Find them through missions, envoys or by visiting their gates.
kultivator.guide.c16.sekutu.title: Forge an alliance
kultivator.guide.c16.sekutu.body:
Send envoys and gifts until they are Friendly, then propose a pact.
Allies send guards when the sect is attacked and invite you to joint tournaments.
kultivator.guide.c16.perang.title: Win a sect war
kultivator.guide.c16.perang.body:
A hostile sect may declare war and raid your territory.
Go to their gate and defeat their master to win; without a gate, the enemy master comes to your Hall after a challenge letter.
Three raids that sack your sect lose the war.
